overview_description.description:
STRABL is a Payments & Checkout solution, providing a SaaS based solution that integrates with E-Commerce merchants and businesses that offer digital payments enabling them with  purchasing options like "Try Before You Buy, Pay Later and Zero Pay Checkout".
STRABL enhances the customer journey experience through it's world's fastest checkout system and integrated logistics support.
While providing one-stop multiple payment method integration to save costs & reduce complexities.

product.name: Zero Pay Checkout
product.description: Allows customers to receive products or services without upfront payment, offering the flexibility to pay after delivery.

product.name: Express Checkout
product.description: Provides a 1-Click Checkout solution for a rapid purchase process, increasing conversions and customer satisfaction.

product.name: Try Now Buy Later
product.description: Enables customers to try out a device before making a purchase decision, reducing hesitation in buying used electronics.

product.name: Multiple Payment Methods
product.description: Offers a variety of payment options to customers, enhancing their purchasing flexibility.

product.name: Fraud Prevention
product.description: Implements security measures to protect businesses and customers from deceptive transactions.

product.name: Financing Options
product.description: Provides micro-financing options, allowing customers to split or defer payments.
